description: This is a Java interface defining a messaging component for internal use within a larger system. It provides a method to obtain the origin ActorRef of a message, encapsulating the concept of message origin tracking.

classes.name: WithOrigin
classes.description: An interface for messages that contain an origin ActorRef, allowing retrieval of the message's origin.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ActorRef where the message originated from, or empty if the origin is not specified.
